copyright_or_patent_royalties.age_condition: Attained age 65 on or before the last day of the taxable year.
copyright_or_patent_royalties.secretary_finding: Shows to the satisfaction of the Secretary that the royalties and property meet the statutory conditions.
copyright_or_patent_royalties.property_timing_condition: Copyright or patent obtained before the taxable year in which the individual attained age 65.
copyright_or_patent_royalties.personal_effort_condition: Property to which the copyright or patent relates was created by the individual own personal efforts.
copyright_or_patent_royalties.effect: Exclude such royalties from gross income for RET NESE/net-loss computation.

verified_changes.original_b_baseline: Section 325(a)(1) excludes 211(c)(1), (4), (5) from the ordinary definition and adds the D gross-income exclusion; this 1965 baseline does not verify every intervening amendment of B.
verified_changes.replaces_prior_refusal: Original 1965 (D) text is now obtained and verified; do not continue listing its absence as an unresolved dependency.

verified_changes.replaces_prior_refusal: Full 416(l) schedule and absence of later listed (l) amendments are verified; the prior fragment dependency on unreconstructed 416(l) history is answered.
verified_changes.age_reference: Applicable individual retirement age; year attaining early retirement age and benefit type determine the schedule, not income year alone.
verified_changes.before_dependent_reference: Original 1965 (D) used age 65; the 1983 act replaces the age reference with 416(l), subject to its amendment/effective history already recorded in ret_history_government.

remaining_refusals.reason: Historical 409 retirement-payment exclusions and all plan-definition/transition interactions still require complete verification. The targeted 1984 transitions already recorded do not establish every earlier plan rule.

RET contribution calculation continues refusing whenever any year-specific 411 eligible-concept/factor, 409 threshold, timing, age or church-income dependency is unverified. Closing original (D) and 416(l) does not establish the whole concept.
